scenes.say: October is done. November the first was the turn.
On Friday, we listened to every one of you. Now we mean it.
Here is your day, from both sides. Seven o'clock: your goal, your fact finds, your clients. And our team is already chasing your cases.
By half past ten, you check in, and you are present. Not checked in? We call, to understand.
At noon, tell us how it's going. Need help? Your manager hears it, straight away.
By six, you close off. What you planned, and what you did. We see it too.
You see us. We see you. Everyone is accountable.
Every fact find is followed. Each open case asks you: did this close? Two weeks with no fact find, and Monday's note says your response is required. By Wednesday, your manager is copied.
Since August, one hundred and twenty-five fact finds. Every month, more clients confirm, and sign. October, our best yet: fifteen confirmed. Twenty-five signed.

Your fact finds have a journey too. The plan goes to your client the same day. A reminder on day three, another on day eight, then we ask you to call. More than half of all confirmations came after a reminder, and thirty of thirty-two ratings are five stars.

When a fact find stalls, your own notes tell us why. The client wants time, or the budget is tight. After the call we ask you to make, six more said yes. Five within hours. Sixteen are still waiting. Let's call them, this week.
No more guessing. The system shows us where every one of us stands. Then we coach in person. A call, a visit, a sit-down, with the facts in hand.
Coming this month: your dashboard at seven. A bell for whatever needs you. Follow who inspires you, and share what works, straight into the week's wins.
Rajiv went first. His updates on the record. Seven applications in October.
That is the level. Every one of us, there.
To every one of you who stayed the course: thank you. You built this with us, and now we reap it, together.
Check in. Lift each other. Rise.
